LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Title: A seer at the end of the season
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Text: {SEER}, {OF}, came to the colony as the season was ending, sat down near the middle and {CAST}. {WHO} {SEER} said:\n\n{WORDS}
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_OfFold: a seer of the arcane fold
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Cast_0: threw small bones into the ashes of the fire and looked at how they fell
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Cast_1: laid out a deck of painted cards on the ground
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Cast_2: held a pendulum over a hand-drawn map of the area
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Cast_3: went through a column of readings on a handheld screen
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Listener: {LISTENER} went over and sat down to listen.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_NoListener: Nobody was free to sit with them, so they said it to whoever was near.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Word_Frost: It will freeze. The next season averages {TEMP} here.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Word_Cold: It will be cold. The next season averages {TEMP} here.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Word_Mild: It will be mild. The next season averages {TEMP} here.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Word_Warm: It will be warm. The next season averages {TEMP} here.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Word_Heat: It will be very hot. The next season averages {TEMP} here.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Word_Grows: The fields will grow. Crops grow at that temperature.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Word_Bare: Nothing will grow. It will be too cold or too hot for crops.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Word_StoresShort: The stores will run short. The colony has food for less than fifteen days, and nothing will grow.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Word_StoresEnough: The stores will last. The colony has food for forty days or more.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Seer_Word_Blades: A fight is coming. An attack on the colony is due within fifteen days.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_OneWay_Text: At midnight everyone awake in the colony stopped and turned to face {POINT}: {WHO}. Their shadows stretched out that way across the ground. It lasted about ten seconds.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_OneWay_Dead: They were all facing where {DEAD} lies.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_OneWay_Edge: Nobody could see anything out there in the dark.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_OneWay_DawnFound: At dawn {WALKER} walked out the way everyone had faced and found {THING} lying at the edge of the land.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_OneWay_DawnDead: At dawn {WALKER} went and stood for a while where {DEAD} lies.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Stone_Text: At dusk {STONE} near the middle of the colony began to hum, a low steady sound, {WHY}. It will go on until early morning, and the animals are keeping away from it.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Stone_Psychic: while the psychic disturbance was on
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Stone_Quiet: The stone stopped humming in the early morning.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Scroll_Title: A sealed scroll in the ruins
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Scroll_Text: In {RUIN}, {FINDER} noticed something lying in the dust: {THING}, still sealed. {FINDER} went over and knelt down beside it.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Charged_Text: {SKY}, and the colony's casters lit up where they stood:\n\n{NAMES}
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Charged_Power: Tonight the sky was full of power
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Charged_Aurora: Tonight there was an aurora over the colony
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Charged_Mage: {NAME}: light ran over their hands, and their mana is full.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Charged_Sensitive: {NAME}: they felt it go right through them.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Charged_Burned: The light came out of {NAME}'s hands too fast and burned them.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Enchanter_Who_2: a travelling tinker who works on gear with tools nobody else uses
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Enchanter_Text: {ENCHANTER}, {WHO}, has come to the colony. They have looked at {BEARER}'s {THING} ({QUALITY}) and say they can make it {NEXT} in about an hour, for {PRICE} silver.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Enchanter_Ask: If the colony agrees, {BEARER} will take it over to them and stay while they work.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Enchanter_NoSilver: The colony doesn't have {PRICE} silver in its stores.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Enchanter_Done: {ENCHANTER} and {BEARER} stood over the {THING} for about an hour while {ENCHANTER} worked on it. It is now {NEXT}. {ENCHANTER} was paid {PRICE} silver from the stores and went on their way.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Buried_Knock: Something knocked under the ground to the {POINT} of the colony's middle during the night, and dust rose from the spot.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Buried_Crack: The knocking under the ground came again, and the earth over it has cracked.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Buried_Title: Something came up out of the ground
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Buried_Text: This morning the cracked ground near the colony broke open, and {WHAT}: {FOUND}.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Buried_Cache: an old buried cache was lying in it
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Buried_Relic: something old and valuable was lying in it
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Buried_Magicyte: raw magicyte had pushed up through the soil
LanguageData.CC_OldP_BuriedWaker_Title: The dead came up out of the ground
LanguageData.CC_OldP_BuriedWaker_Text: This morning the cracked ground near the colony broke open, and {COUNT} of the dead climbed out of it. They are coming for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_DeadRoad_Text: At dusk a line of pale figures came walking across the land from the {FROM}, {WHY}. They walk slowly and do not look at the colony.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_DeadRoad_AfterDeath: a few days after a death in the colony
LanguageData.CC_OldP_DeadRoad_NoMoon: on a night with no moon
LanguageData.CC_OldP_DeadRoad_Walkers: At dusk the dead came walking across the land, {WHY}.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_DeadRoad_Gone: The pale figures walked off the edge of the land and were gone.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Pilgrims_Text: {COUNT} pilgrims of {PEOPLE} came onto the land {WHY}. They have stopped at {PLACE} to pray before they go on.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Pilgrims_Sign: because of the sign in the sky
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Pilgrims_Token: The pilgrims left {TOKEN} at {PLACE} and went on their way.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_OtherSky_Text_0: Tonight the sky over the colony is violet, the shadows are green, and the stars are not the usual stars. It should last until early morning.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_OtherSky_Text_1: Tonight the sky over the colony is violet, the shadows are green, and none of the stars are where they should be. It should last until early morning.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_OtherSky_Text_2: Tonight the sky over the colony is violet, the shadows are green, and the stars don't match any star chart. It should last until early morning.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_OtherSky_Text_3: Tonight the sky over the colony is violet, the shadows are green, and the stars match no sky in the colony's star charts. It should last until early morning.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_OtherSky_Gone: The night sky looks as it should again.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_Beast_Text: At dusk {BEAST} walked up to {HEARER}, stood in front of them and spoke. {HEARER} says it said: {WORDS} Then it walked away like any other animal.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_GodPasses_Text: All night there were signs at the colony, {COUNT} of them, one after another. By dawn they had stopped.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_GodPasses_Named: {KEEPER}, who holds to that god, says it went past the colony in the night without stopping.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_GodPasses_Unnamed: Some say something went past the colony in the night.
LanguageData.CC_OldP_GodPasses_Saw: {WHO} saw signs all night at {HOME}, one after another, and then nothing more.
